title: Add VS Code Agents to Copilot usage metrics
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot usage metrics now expose VS Code Agents-window activity separately, including aggregate active users and per-user usage indicators for enterprise and organization reporting.
actionable_takeaway: Create an adoption receipt that separates VS Code Agents window metrics from editor Agent Mode and generic Copilot usage rollups, treating optional/null fields as unavailable rather than zero.

title: Auto-resolution and analysis updates in Copilot code review
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot code review can automatically resolve addressed comments, generate smarter autofix commit messages, use a broader shell-tool set, and apply a Lite effort ensemble of agents.
actionable_takeaway: Add a review closure gate that records which comments auto-closed after a fix commit, which remain open, the validation commands used, and the final human review decision.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - September 7
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: The weekly release bundles Jira-to-canvas workflows, HydraFusion adaptive model orchestration, VS Code recurring agent tasks, voice mode, issue/PR details in Agents, and JetBrains sandbox policy controls.
actionable_takeaway: Model the product loop as a task capsule: requirement source, shared canvas, recurring task, implementation, PR, review, policy boundary, and completion evidence.

title: ChatGPT and Codex changelog - September 2026
author: OpenAI Developers
why_it_matters: September desktop updates include quick chats, Pets, Appshots for Windows, command confirmation fixes, and Codex Pro workspace permissions and model fallback notes.
actionable_takeaway: Use quick chat, voice, and Appshots as control-plane inputs while keeping file writes, tests, commits, pushes, and deploys on the Mac/Codex evidence plane.

title: Data plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
author: OpenAI Product Release Notes
why_it_matters: The Data plugin gives ChatGPT Work and Codex a product-level path to read organizational data, increasing the need for clear query, permission, and public-output boundaries.
actionable_takeaway: Before using data-backed Codex workflows, define a read-only query allowlist, private-result storage boundary, redaction rules, and a public-summary-only output contract.

title: Agents API public beta
author: OpenAI Product Release Notes
why_it_matters: OpenAI's product release notes list Agents API public beta, reinforcing that agent runtime primitives are moving into mainstream API surfaces.
actionable_takeaway: Create an Agents API upgrade gate covering schema, tool calls, permission failures, tracing fields, streaming behavior, and Node/Python parity.

title: GPT-Live 1 generally available
author: OpenAI Product Release Notes
why_it_matters: GPT-Live 1 GA makes low-latency voice/realtime workflows more production-like and raises the bar for interruption, cleanup, and evidence handling in agent control surfaces.
actionable_takeaway: Add realtime smoke tests for connect, interrupt, cancel, stream cleanup, unsuccessful response reporting, and local-only process evidence.

title: API key expiration controls
author: OpenAI Product Release Notes
why_it_matters: API key expiration controls shift long-running automations from permanent-token assumptions toward scheduled credential lifecycle management.
actionable_takeaway: Attach a credential receipt to each automation with owner, scope, expiration, rotation reminder, fallback behavior, and no-secret logging checks.

title: Rethinking skills and prompts for GPT-6 Astra
author: OpenAI Developers / Nisan Stiennon
why_it_matters: The article argues that frontier agents like GPT-6 Astra need leaner prompts and skills focused on context, boundaries, and high-signal examples rather than encyclopedic step lists.
actionable_takeaway: Run a skill context slimming audit: remove duplicate background and obsolete step-by-step rules, preserve boundaries and validation commands, then measure quality and rework.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.154.0 stable release
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex 0.154.0 adds GPT-6 Astra picker support, experimental worktrees, inline answers while work continues, Windows background server support, richer copy behavior, and permission preservation fixes.
actionable_takeaway: Test worktree and inline-answer flows in an isolated lane, ensuring fresh sessions and forks preserve model defaults and permissions before changing default team workflows.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-5 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds session and memory import commands for semantic JSONL, grammar-generated shell completions, absolute sandbox path display, resource catalogue trust details, and per-model AI credit breakdowns.
actionable_takeaway: Update CLI smoke tests for JSONL import, shell completion grammar, absolute sandbox paths, resource trust metadata, per-model usage, and parsing changes.

title: Automating repetitive work at OpenAI with Codex, Runme, and WebMCP
author: OpenAI Developers / Jacob Lee
why_it_matters: The case study shows how notebook-style Runme workflows and WebMCP browser control can turn repetitive visual update tasks into repeatable Codex-assisted procedures.
actionable_takeaway: For browser or UI-assisted automation, preserve the evidence loop: observe pre-state, declare action, execute, read back post-state, validate, and keep screenshots local only.
